The documents don't name a type called `bitvec`. The closest is the `bit` type, and the retrieved text doesn't state a maximum number of dimensions for the type itself. The Bit Type section only covers storage: "Each bit vector takes `dimensions / 8 + 8` bytes of storage." [pgvector/README.md]

The only related limit is for indexing, not for the type. The FAQ says you can use "[binary quantization](#binary-quantization) to index up to 64,000 dimensions." [pgvector/README.md]

If you mean the `bit` type, 64,000 is the indexing limit the docs give. I don't know the maximum for storing `bit` values without an index.
